faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the questions we hear most often. Can't find yours? Get in touch.

items.question: Which industries do you serve?
items.answer: We serve every industry — healthcare, education, finance, hospitality, manufacturing, retail and more. Healthcare is our flagship vertical, where we build purpose-built hospital and clinic software; for every industry we deliver software, cybersecurity, networking, cloud, data, consulting and managed IT services, plus genuine IT infrastructure products.

items.question: Do you offer managed IT services?
items.answer: Yes. Our managed IT services cover proactive monitoring, 24/7 helpdesk, patch management, network monitoring and preventive maintenance.

items.question: Can you build custom software for our organisation?
items.answer: Yes, for organisations of every kind. Custom software development is one of our core services — from hospital management systems and clinical applications for healthcare, to bespoke platforms for finance, education, retail and more — delivered with modern frameworks and agile practice.

items.question: Do you provide cybersecurity solutions?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver next-generation firewalls, endpoint security, SOC services and data security to protect your organisation from evolving threats.

items.question: Where is TechBucket based?
items.answer: We are a Nepal-based company with our headquarters in Kathmandu, serving clients across the country and beyond.
